rows.ARS:
Pink blend Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: JACnor
Exhibition name: Signature ®
rows.Origin:
Bred by William A. Warriner (United States, before 1992).
Introduced in United States by Bear Creek Gardens, Inc. in 1996 as 'Signature'.
rows.Bloom: Rose-pink, light pink blending. Fruity fragrance. 30 to 35 petals. Average diameter 4.75". Large, full (26-40 petals), borne mostly solitary, classic hybrid tea, exhibition, high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season. Long, pointed buds.
rows.Habit:
Tall, upright. Large, semi-glossy, dark green foliage.

Height: 4' to 5' (120 to 150cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b and warmer. Can be used for cut flower, exhibition or garden. Vigorous. Disease susceptibility: mildew resistant, susceptible to rust . Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) . Can be grown in the ground or in a container (container requires winter protection).
